items.title: Doc Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, New York City, New York, July 28, 1995
items.q: I knew Ma Rainey because I sat in the Bijou Theater playing shows with the pit band.

ctx.x: Can you tell us about your first recording date?

items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: Ma Rainey would draw the roughest crowd... I never played there... During that time, maybe a few Ma Rainey's but Mame Smith -- everybody had a recording of Mame Smith.

ctx.x: -- and Ma Rainey was actually working --
Yes, Ma Rainey was working at that time.
